description: This Java source file defines the LoginEvents class, which handles user login, password recovery, and email password reset functionalities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for saving login parameters, showing password hints, sending password reset emails, and managing login sessions.

classes.name: LoginEvents
classes.description: Handles user login, password recovery, and email password reset processes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: saveEntryParams
methods.description: Saves USERNAME and PASSWORD parameters into session attributes for later use during authentication.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Determines whether to show password hint or email password reset based on request parameters.

methods.name: showPasswordHint
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the password hint for a given user login ID.

methods.name: emailPasswordRequest
methods.description: Sends an email with a link to reset the password, generating a JWT token and configuring email content.

methods.name: storeCheckLogin
methods.description: Checks user login status and verifies store customer role.

methods.name: storeLogin
methods.description: Performs login and store role verification, handling login response.
